question: Why did our webhook stop working?

model.source: recorded from openai/gpt-oss-120b through the openai provider

replies.text: Your webhook `wh_31c9` was automatically disabled after it hit a large number of consecutive failures. The system recorded 50 failures, the last one being a timeout after 10 seconds, and disabled the webhook on 2026‑09‑30 (see obs:2) 【obs:2】. When a webhook repeatedly can’t deliver its POST requests, Fernway disables it to stop further attempts. [help:webhooks@2#0]
